hash_policy: Explicit user task prohibits SHA/hash computation; retained paths, sizes, mtimes and field-level content comparisons instead.

gt_provenance.details: Real modality-specific HBB labels. Legacy Drone pairing uses same-class IoU >= 0.1; D1 uses >= 0.5. LLVIP identical labels do not establish independent geometric truth. Overlap transformed RGB GT agrees within 4.31e-5 input px, 0 class mismatches.

score_normalization.details: Pre-NMS D1 geometry assignment is not post-NMS detector error rate; sequential state labels confound dimensions. D2 CE is RGB GT DFL at temperature 1; local gradients are box-logit proxies. CKA is centered per image, with differing valid foreground subsets by level.

result_existence.details: Read raw prediction records, D1/D2 JSONL, energy NPZ and all six N/C0 full-dev object dumps. Independently counted rows, unique objects, predictions and GT identity.

dead_code.details: Read executed trainer/loss snapshots and confirm emitted field names and calculations match artifacts. Did not infer execution from a definition alone.
evidence: EXPERIMENT_AUDIT.md#3-定位-d2-的真实覆盖及字段语义

scope.details: Legacy RGB/IR probes use one checkpoint seed. 200-image cohorts overlap only 30 Drone/13 LLVIP images; full path prevents stem collisions. New N/C0 models and rectangular 544x672 inference differ from legacy 640x640. Remote checkpoint contents and actual image pixels were not accessed.

eval_type.details: GT boxes and class comparisons are real_gt; CKA, activation energy and local DFL logit-gradient alignment are self_supervised_proxy. Neither implies distillation benefit.

claims.rationale: Descriptively, 2719 low-confidence versus 248 wrong-class objects satisfy R IoU>=.5 and reliable T own/RGB IoU>=.5; validation 321 versus 37. Not a KD effect estimate.
